entities.summary: The Concession of Evoramonte, also known as the Convention of Evoramonte, is a peace treaty signed on 26 May 1834, in the town of Evoramonte, Alentejo, between the Constitutionalists and the Miguelites, that ended the Portuguese Civil War (1828–1834).
